localEligibility.rest-sleep: only continuous clear inactive >=~5min, no active work, pending ask/permission, unknown connection, menu/drag; visible only; hidden resets, never catch-up play
localEligibility.wake: fresh local input/new task/error/permission/unknown excludes rest immediately; use actual drawing recovery; never changes OS sleep or Host status
localEligibility.hover-response: actual character alpha-hitmask residency ~700ms; 10s cooldown; leave recovers; transparent padding/global cursor ignored; closed endpoint only
localEligibility.tap-response: actual local tap only, no double-click semantics, no task approval or completion; no forced computer close; existing v2 open tap remains in use
localEligibility.yawn: once in rest entry, not a repeating hold action
localEligibility.reducedMotion: suppress optional rest/hover recurrence; keep canonical closed and necessary current-pose return
localEligibility.wakeReset: Any fresh input, tap, hover attention wake or new task clears continuous-idle eligibility; runtime must not return to sleep on the next frame.

acceptedSourceBoundary: No v2 source overwritten. Normalized-reference PNGs are processing references and never runtime sources.
anatomicalNote: Yawn uses character RIGHT/image-LEFT hand. Image-right hand remains on closed laptop. After yawn returns, image-right hand can rest on own skirt; not stool.

tap-response.open: reuse existing v2 open tap, no v3 substitution

relax-idle.condition: clear inactive only, low-frequency local rest; never a repeated yawn loop

idle-closed.implementation: keep selected v2 closed-idle unchanged; do not replace ordinary quiet with sleep
